name: test-badge
description: After a turn that edited source files, runs the project's tests and lint in the background and shows a one-line badge (tests 41/42 · lint 2 errors · 4s ago) with a details pane listing each failure by suite and file:line

testCommand.title: Test command
testCommand.description: Overrides the detected test command (run with /bin/sh -c in the project root); empty = auto-detect

lintCommand.title: Lint command
lintCommand.description: Overrides the detected lint command (run with /bin/sh -c in the project root); empty = auto-detect

openCommand.title: Open command
openCommand.description: How a failure row opens its file, e.g. "cursor -g {file}:{line}" (no shell); empty = VS Code's code -g, then the OS opener
